quest.title: The Tale of the Gate Stone
quest.description: In the center of the Frostmoon Enclave, you discover a strange large stone...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Hmm... Doesn't seem to be this one either...

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: #Oh, hello there, {M#Big Bro}{F#Big Sis}. I don't think I've seen you before... or the white fae lady next to you.

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Frostmoon Enclave! Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Nope, we just got curious, seeing you out here all alone like this. By the way, Paimon's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: #So it's {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} {NICKNAME} and Miss Paimon! Hmm... Y'know, you two don't look like you're from Nasha Town.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! Super awesome adventurers, at that!

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Must be nice though — traveling around with your best friend, seeing the world together...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It really is! We've been to so many places already! What about you? What were you doing out here just now?

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: I was looking for pretty stones.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! You collect them, right? You're not the only one — some grown-ups are super into that too!

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Nope! I'm gonna use the pretty stones to bribe Mai into kidnapping me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, that makes sen— wait, what!?

choices.text: That's... definitely not what I was expecting...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Hmm? You've never heard the story of the legendary thief Reed Miller and the fae princess? But Mai told me it's super famous outside...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: "Come, lady with moonlit eyes, let me steal your heart with this jewel that matches your gaze, and whisk you away from this gilded cage..."

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: I'm not really sure what it means, but... if you give someone something they like, that means you can go on an adventure with them, right?

choices.text: That's not what it means at all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yeah... It actually means... Uh... anyway, it's not exactly a story for kids!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, who is this Mai you're talking about? Telling kids strange stories like that... That sounds kinda questionable!

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: She's not a bad person! And she's about the same age as me.

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: She's an adventurer too, just like you two! I caught her sneaking around near camp once, so I made her tell me a story.

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: For some reason, she seemed to think we were some scary cult of weirdos who sacrifice kidnapped kids to the Moon Goddess. She tried to act all calm while begging me not to kill her...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of weird misunderstanding is that...?

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Right? I have no idea where she even heard something like that. It's so strange. But since it sounded kinda funny, I didn't bother correcting her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's exactly why you should've corrected her!

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Anyway, in exchange, she promised to be my best friend and told me lots and lots of stories about the outside world.

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Mom and Dad never let me read stories from the outside world, saying only non-believers would like such worthless things... But Mai's stories were really interesting!

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Like the fisherman who fell in love with a fae, the thief who died three times but escaped from the Lady of the Underworld thrice, and the changeling who longed to become human...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: There were kind people, not-so-kind people, and really, really bad people. Rich or poor, good or evil... in the end, everyone dies in misery.

choices.text: Okay, yeah, your parents have a point... those are pretty messed up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, definitely not the kind of stories you tell kids...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: But I'm not a kid anymore. Mai also said that the outside world's way too dangerous for someone like me...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Which is kinda rich from her. She can't even use the bless{RUBY#[S]kuuvahki}ing of the Moon Goddess, and she's about the same age as me.

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Still, it's fine! I'm super smart, anyway. Before I caught her, she kept muttering about some "stone"... That means she must be looking for pretty stones, right?

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: If I find some <color=#00E1FFFF>pretty stones</color>, I bet I can bribe her with ease! Just like how Reed Miller lured the fae lady away, she'll take me away from here, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Can you not say "bribe" like that? You're just giving your friend a nice gift — that's totally normal! No need to make it sound weird!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we'll be looking around this area anyway, so if we find any pretty pieces, we'll bring them back to you.

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Wow, really? Thank you so much!

choices.text: Wow... I really wanna hear the whole thing. Could you tell me more?

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: Okay. For example, Reed Miller's companion, the "Shadow Weasel" who swore to never step into the moonlight again...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Now's not the time for stories like that! And anyway... those aren't exactly stories for kids!

choices.text: That's right, that's how I lured Paimon onto this path...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't teach kids weird things! Just because Paimon loves your cooking doesn't mean our friendship started with a "kidnapping"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, this is not normal, even here!

choices.text: Actually... I'm the real mastermind behind the scenes in Nasha Town...

response.speaker: Kasha
response.text: #Whoa, seriously? That sounds so cool! Can I be your follower then, {NICKNAME}? You know, like in one of those epic stories?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, quit messing around! We're just regular adventurers passing through, okay!? No way we're secretly pulling all the strings in Nasha Town or anything... at least, not that Paimon knows of...

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: #I know I'm not a kid anymore, but I still need to grow a bit to reach that high. Could you give me a hand, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Kasha, would you consider this a pretty stone?

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Wow, that was fast! You really are professional adventurers. You're amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, most stuff's easy-peasy for us! Short of exploring some crazy-deep underground labyrinth, or taking photos at spots thousands of miles apart, maybe...

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Mmm... Hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's a beautiful stone, sure, but I feel like it seems to be attracted to this big stone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Paimon doesn't feel anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: I'm not really sure either... It's just a vague hunch, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: It's like... how Mai mentioned that Reed Miller encountered the fae princess through the guidance of the Moon Goddess. I guess this premonition of mine must be something similar...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, is this what they call foresight? But wait — Paimon's pretty sure the Moon Goddess wouldn't bother with something like that... She's probably way too busy for that kind of thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... what does your premonition tell you to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Hmm... For example, that we should put this stone back there?

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: #I know I'm not a kid anymore, but I still need to grow a bit to reach that high. Could you give me a hand, {NICKNAME}?

talks.objective: Place the fragment(s) on the stone

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Wow, I was right! As soon as we put the two stones together, something really awesome happened!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Umm, but now the stone we just found is gone...

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Oh, it's okay! I was only trying to find fragments like that so I could bribe Mai in the first place...

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Now that we've got this whole new story about a flying stone, the stone itself doesn't really matter anymore. Since Mai loves telling stories, I'm sure she'll be way more excited about this tale than just some old rocks!

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: #Thank you so much, {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Things didn't go exactly as I imagined, but I'm really happy with how it all turned out!

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Oh! And here's a pretty stone I found earlier. I think it's really beautiful, so I want you to have it as a thank-you gift!

dialogues.speaker: Kasha
dialogues.text: Thank you so much! It would be great if I could find <color=#00E1FFFF>pretty stones</color> nearby...
